description: Abstract Controller class for Goteo application, providing methods for rendering responses, handling forms, database caching, and event dispatching.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Abstract base class providing core functionalities for controllers in the Goteo framework.

methods.name: viewResponse
methods.description: Renders a view with variables, adjusting content type for AJAX or debug mode.

methods.name: rawResponse
methods.description: Returns a plain text or file attachment response.

methods.name: jsonResponse
methods.description: Returns a JSON response, pretty-printed in debug mode.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL or current request URI.

methods.name: contextVars
methods.description: Adds variables to all views, optionally within a specific view path context.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a specific service from the container.

methods.name: createFormBuilder
methods.description: Creates a form builder with default options.

methods.name: getModelForm
methods.description: Creates a form processor for a model with validation options.

methods.name: getEntityForm
methods.description: Creates a form processor for an entity with validation options.
